name: Muks Robotics Spaceo PRO
summary: An Indian wheeled enterprise humanoid with two 6-DOF arms (5 kg each), a height-adjustable chassis and waist, and an integrated base trolley for up to 200 kg, aimed at material handling, sorting and inspection in plants and warehouses. It is offered for pilots.

germany.statusNote: Muks Robotics (Pune, India) offers Spaceo PRO for pilots through its own sales contact. No German or EU route was found.

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: waist and gripper optional; 6 per arm, 2 base, 1 waist, 2 head
specs.quote: Degree of Freedom (Total Joints)20 (Waist and Gripper (optional))

specs.label: Payload per arm
specs.quote: Each arm supports up to 5 kg for precise pick-and-place tasks

specs.label: Base trolley payload
specs.quote: the integrated base trolley carries up to 200 kg

specs.label: Operational workspace height
specs.conditions: adjustable chassis height and waist rotation
specs.quote: Adjustable chassis height and dynamic waist rotation allows the robot to have an operational workspace from 0 to 145 cm.

specs.label: Battery life
specs.conditions: about 4 h; standby 72 h; 25.6 V 45 Ah LiFePO4

specs.label: AI computing module
specs.quote: AI Computing ModuleJetson Orin AGX (~275 TOPS)

specs.label: Hand degrees of freedom
specs.quote: Single Hand Degrees of Freedom1 to 16 (As per gripper)

notes: End effector is chosen per order: grippers from 1 to 16 DOF.
The maker lists secondary development as 'Ongoing'.
